200. The Secret of the Bement Royal Family (2)
There was a passage leading to the underground world beneath the uninhabited island where the Bement royal family was hiding.

Strictly speaking, it was not a passage leading to the underworld, which means a complete underground, but a passage leading to the 'intermediate floor' where beings like Ameris resided after the world was divided in half.

That passage was not made by the royal family or by the current owner of the island, the Lutero Federation. It was a path made by the Blue Tribe during the ancient 'Sun War'. The passages made by each power that held hegemony at that time were still scattered throughout the world.
Only the royal family among the ground forces knew this fact. Ameris had forgotten the existence of the passages due to memory errors caused by the seal.

"Since I felt the great snake awakening, thankfully, the situation we feared did not occur. If the great snake's memory and powers were intact, none of the sealed tribes on the intermediate floor could have survived."
After Bivol left, Airan spoke with a smile.
Airan confirmed the state of Ameris based on the fact that the Red Tribe was recklessly frolicking in the world. He said neither power, authority, nor memory are intact.
The same was true for the Red Tribe.

It's true that Jin's power is closest to the peak of the world, but if it was the Rakiman and the Red Fleet in their heyday, the fight wouldn't have been so one-sided. At least they could have resisted somewhat.

"That's right, Your Majesty. It is a great fortune for us that the Red Tribe was immediately put on the defensive as soon as they awakened. Even those arrogant and fierce guys can't reject the hand we're extending."

"Once we successfully inherit their technology through the trade with the Red Tribe, replicating it will no longer be a dream. Moreover, if we start looking for the remains of the Blue Tribe from now, we should be able to awaken Eltiot...... The empire will rise again! It will become an eternal empire that stands tall and cannot be destroyed by anyone!"
The royals did not hide their excited voices.
They have endured eternal humiliation to survive and seize opportunities from ancient times to the present. They have never once ruled as an overwhelmingly strong force during that long period.

In ancient times, they were treated like bugs by the strong tribes like the Red and Blue tribes, and they barely survived the risk of extinction while several civilizations were born and collapsed on the ground after the 'Great Seal'.
Finally, they founded Bement, but as the history of current mankind proves, Bement has never once achieved an absolute status worthy of the name of an empire.
This is because monsters like Runkandel and Gipel existed. Gipel threatened the survival of the empire as soon as it appeared, and when it could no longer endure, Runkandel appeared.
From that moment on, another thousand years.
The Empire had been playing a precarious balancing act, depending on the whims of the two families, and now only the ancient members of the imperial family managed to hide their existence.
So, what the imperial family of Bement desired was just one thing.
Complete and secure survival.
The power to rule the world alone was the most essential means to realize that. The imperial family had no interest in the resurrection of the Sun God.
Rather, they were in a position where they had to definitely prevent it. If the Sun God resurrected, they would have to live a bug-like life again according to their given fate.

"As soon as Bibol returns, we will start looking for the buried members of the Cheongmyeong tribe. Check each regional passage. The enemies, especially Lunkandel, can use the abilities of Ameris and the record mage, so they will soon know the existence of the buried members of the Cheongmyeong tribe. We must secure them first."
"Understood, Your Majesty!"

"If our trade with the enemy is successful, the situation on the ground will change very quickly. The enemy will run wildly... In that hasty change, we will be the ones to not lose our center till the end. Also, as always, we will be the only ones to survive till the end."
As the members of the royal family scattered, Ayrain remained alone in the meeting room, watching out the window. A cool breeze was blowing.
October 8, 1803.

It's been exactly a week since Jin drove out the enemy tribe that attacked Kinzelo's third base. After that day, there were no signs of the enemy tribe in the world. At least that was the case according to the Bamel Federation, Zipl, and Kinzelo.
In fact, the enemy tribe just didn't hunt on the ground, and Lakiman and Simat had already met Ayrain in person and finished the deal.

And both the enemy tribe and the imperial family have already given each other a lot of benefits. The enemy tribe has opened a second castle in an instant with the blood of humans and old buried ones sent by Ayrain, and the imperial family is cultivating weapons with their technology.
Everything happened out of sight of the giant forces' surveillance network. It's the privilege of those who first used the middle layer.
"BeraDyne has been making quite a rough move since becoming the head of the family."
Jin said, reviewing the newsletters.

Special news was pouring out every day. The day BeraDyne became head of the family, the rebellion of Kelliac in the background, the underground world, the appearance of Ameris and the enemy tribe, Jin who woke them up.
All of these stories were being disclosed to the public.
"Journalists from Zipl's side are consistently arguing that Gongja is awakening the beings of the underworld, threatening the world."
At Casimir's words, Jin nodded.
"It feels like they're trying to create a pretext for war. The argument that it's self-defense for Zipl to attack Lunkandel and the Bamel Alliance because I threatened the world first."

"Even after seeing the power of Gongja and the God of War in the Hyungsintemple, and the power of our alliance, they are doing this... because they believe in something. It will be related to the power of the Devil's Stone, or Zipl's sanctuary."
Of course.
Jin wanted to delay the war as much as possible. To complete the golden fleet, pull out his brothers from Laprarosa, and for Murakan to return.

If possible, he wanted to start the war after he himself had ascended to Changseong. Because the war that was fought with all these conditions would not be a war of blood, madness, and wounds, but literally overwhelming.
If only they could completely overwhelm the enemies, they could clean up the world without unnecessary death and destruction.
In other words, they could fight while protecting the lives of ordinary people as much as possible.

At present, this was impossible, and beyond that, they had to fight an extremely disadvantageous fight. The only power that considered civilians across the ground and the underground was the Bamel Alliance.
"BeraDyne knows exactly what I fear most. The death of a colleague, and the death of innocent people. If the war starts quickly, I will lose a lot. Even if we win."
These are the nightmares he has already experienced in the Hyungsintemple.

Rather, in the war between the giant forces, there would be even more sacrifices. The whole world would become a battlefield, and in the end, the winner would only face a desolate landscape that would never exist again.
This made Jin's heart heavy.
A sense of debt that he had to bear because he was a returnee.
Jin recalled the testament left to him through Dante just before Ron, who had ascended to Changseong in the past, died.
-You did nothing wrong, he told me. It's what he said to me and you.

'Yes... All of these things might not be my fault, but that doesn't mean I can ignore them. No matter what happens, I have to keep going by doing what I need to do. I have to be, the best of this world.'
Effort to become the best of the world.

That was the only thing that pushed away the pain of being a returnee that Jin had. Like someone who had just shaken off a nightmare, Jin changed his expression and made eye contact with his colleagues.

"The war will start soon. Even if it's not a full-scale war, local battles will definitely happen. Even if it's not BeraDyne, there is a very high chance that the enemy tribe will start more aggressive activities in the world after recovering from the damage. After we repelled them, Valeria investigated the Kinzelo 3rd base, not only Zipl but also the remnants of the royal family had sent people there."
"There was intelligence that Zipl has been looking for the whereabouts of the remnants of the royal family all along."
Quintell said, pointing to the report.

"Not only Zipl, but we have been tracking them continuously since the fake Yona incident. Using every possible method, including Valeria's record magic. But so far, we haven't caught their tail once, so we can't exclude the assumption that they might be hiding somewhere other than the ground."
"I agree with you, Quintell. Those mystics must have some hidden abilities. If it's related to the underground, this could be an opportunity for them."

"As far as I know, there are no such secrets in the royal family... Hmm. Looking at how Iran Bement suddenly took over power after Amir's death, the former emperor might have been a puppet from the beginning."
In addition to Zipl and the royal family, Kinzelo was also a problem.

[Jeff Lynn, it's almost certain that that demon dragon is one of my heads. If Jeff Lynn wakes up in the future, he will regain some of his memories and powers from that time. Since it's a return of a lost self, it won't be complete. But anyway, it's definitely not a head trying to prevent the resurrection of the Sun God.]
"Hopefully, he'll only regain a part of his power and authority from that time. Or I hope that Jeff Lynn's unconsciousness is not related to Ameris."
[The latter would be great, but it seems better not to expect too much.]
The moment Jeff Lynn said that.
The communication device installed in the conference room emitted a blue light and resonated.
{Sogaju! It's urgent news.}
As soon as he accepted the call, Leot's voice came out.
"Speak, steward."
{The enemy tribe has attacked Zipl.}
"...What? Not Kinzelo, but Zipl?"
{Six hours ago, Zipl's second-class tower located in Ramatan was bombed by the enemy tribe's fleet. Zipl is currently in a state of war.}
The Runecandle and Bamel Alliance thought that if the enemy tribe resumed activities on the ground, they would naturally aim for Kinzelo.
But they daringly touched Zipl, and it was an unexpected development for anyone other than the royal family.
"The fact that they resumed activity so quickly... it seems like they received help from someone."
Jin replied, narrowing his eyes. If it wasn't a self-made play by Zipl, the remnants of the royal family were the most likely suspects.
